class.name: WeChat
class.brief_description: Loads WeChat resource subpackages and mounts their Godot resource packs.
class.description: Available in an exported WeChat Mini Game. Call [method load_resource_subpackage] with a group name from the export preset. Progress, success, and failure are reported by signals. The group's [code]res://[/code] resources are mounted only after WeChat finishes loading that subpackage and the resource pack is read successfully.

method.name: load_resource_subpackage
method.description: Starts loading the named project resource subpackage. Returns [constant OK] when the request is accepted or the pack is already mounted. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when [param name] is not in the package manifest, [constant ERR_BUSY] when that subpackage is already loading, and [constant ERR_UNAVAILABLE] when [code]wx.loadSubpackage[/code] is missing. A returned error is also reported through [signal resource_subpackage_failed], except [constant ERR_BUSY], which leaves the in-progress request unchanged.

signal.name: resource_subpackage_progress
signal.description: Emitted while [param name] is downloading. [param progress] is the WeChat percentage from 0 to 100. The resource pack is not mounted yet.

signal.name: resource_subpackage_loaded
signal.description: Emitted after [param name] has loaded and its Godot resource pack has been mounted. [code]res://[/code] files from that pack can be used after this signal.

signal.name: resource_subpackage_failed
signal.description: Emitted when [param name] cannot be loaded or its resource pack cannot be mounted. The pack is not available.
